name: Fictitious AI | Pro500 launch
description: A fictional AI-assisted product analytics SaaS campaign. One commercial change can affect 104 distinct deliverables across eleven channels. Mixpanel is an external competitor/reference brand; no competitor metric is attributed to this fictional company.

provenance.salesCollateralStatus: SAL-001 is a locally rendered PDF battlecard. Native Google Slides remain supported for actual presentations; the demo presentation is separate.
